item.title: Ex-Army Secretary Driscoll Joins OpenAI as National Security Advisor
item.description:
OpenAI has hired former US Army Secretary Daniel Driscoll as Senior Advisor for National Security and Modernization to promote AI applications in defense and cybersecurity. This move signals OpenAI's continued pivot toward military use cases, following policy changes allowing defense applications and a recent agreement with the Department of Defense.

原文标题：前陆军部长德里斯科尔加入 OpenAI 任国家安全顾问

item.title: Google Proposes VeriCUA to Verify AI Agent Task Completion
item.description:
Google and HKU introduce VeriCUA, a framework that validates computer-use agents by checking saved files and app data instead of relying on screenshots or agent self-reports. This approach reduces false-positive rates from ~25% to 5.4% on ScienceBoard, offering a more reliable verification mechanism for agent evaluation and RL rewards.

原文标题：Google 提出 VeriCUA 框架 校验智能体任务完成状态

Why it matters：解决了智能体“幻觉式成功”这一关键痛点，提供了可落地的验证方法论，对构建可靠智能体系统具有直接指导意义。

item.title: OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra Suspected in Gray Testing as Codex Usage Shows New Model ID
item.description:
Numerous Codex users report discovering a distinct 'gpt-6.2-astra' identifier in usage analytics, suggesting OpenAI may be conducting limited gray or A/B testing for its next-generation model. Although the official API catalog and announcements have not yet confirmed this model or its release date, significant usage shares have appeared in some accounts alongside accelerated quota consumption. This development coincides with rumors of Anthropic's upcoming models, sparking renewed community focus on inference costs and token efficiency.

原文标题：OpenAI GPT-6.2 Astra 疑似灰度测试 Codex 用量现独立标识

Why it matters：虽无官方确认，但多源用户截图与用量数据构成较强实证线索，预示前沿模型迭代节奏加快，值得重度开发者关注潜在的成本与能力变化。

item.title: OpenAI Codex '28-Day Challenge' Ends with 14 Usage Resets
item.description:
OpenAI's '28-Day Update Challenge' for Codex has concluded, featuring daily improvements or usage quota resets as promised by team lead Thibault Sottiaux. Third-party tracking reveals that full quota resets were issued on 14 days during the period, ending with two consecutive banked resets. The initiative aimed to enhance developer experience through rapid iteration, though its primary mechanism relied on compensatory resource distribution rather than singular technical breakthroughs.

原文标题：OpenAI Codex“28 天挑战”结束 共发放 14 次额度重置

item.title: Meta Says US Supply Chain Limits Fourier Robot Partnership; No Sales Plans for Prototype
item.description:
Meta confirmed its partnership with Chinese firm Fourier to develop the 'Max' humanoid robot prototype as a physical embodiment of its Muse AI model. Citing difficulties in sourcing components within the US supply chain, Meta stated the project is strictly for internal research with no plans for commercial sales, while development on a second-generation prototype has already begun.

原文标题：Meta 回应傅利叶合作：因美供应链受限，人形机器人原型暂不出售

Why it matters：揭示了科技巨头在人形机器人领域受地缘政治与供应链制约的现实，以及其当前仍停留在内部实验阶段的战略定位。

item.title: MIT Proposes Weight-Space Programming: LLMs Directly Edit Model Weights to Boost Math Skills
item.description:
MIT CSAIL researchers introduced 'Weight-Space Programming,' a method where GPT-6 Astra directly reads and edits the neural network weights of Qwen3.5-0.8B. Without gradient descent or traditional training loops, adjusting just ~0.016% of parameters eliminated reasoning loops, boosting MATH-500 scores from 7.9% to 48.1%, offering a new paradigm for model optimization and interpretability.

原文标题：MIT 提出权重空间编程：LLM 直接修改模型权重提升数学能力

Why it matters：展示了大模型作为“编译器”直接操作底层权重的突破性能力，显著改变了模型微调与优化的技术路径。

item.title: OpenAI Releases LifeVal Benchmark for Daily Task Execution
item.description:
OpenAI has introduced LifeVal, a new benchmark designed to evaluate AI models' ability to complete actionable and deliverable tasks in real-life scenarios such as caregiving, finance, and education. Built on extensive user surveys, it emphasizes integrating multi-source information tailored to individual contexts rather than just generating lists or advice. Currently, LifeVal remains an internal evaluation tool without public datasets or reproducible code, requiring cautious interpretation of its high scores.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 LifeVal 基准 聚焦日常事务执行能力

Why it matters：填补了通用 AI 在长尾、高复杂度日常生活任务评估上的空白，虽暂不开放但指明了产品化方向。

item.title: MIT CSAIL Experiments Show GPT-6 Astra Modifying Neural Weights Directly
item.description:
An MIT CSAIL team reports preliminary experiments where GPT-6 Astra interpreted and modified neural network weights without writing training loops. In a Qwen test, minor weight adjustments sharply improved math and instruction-following scores, though findings remain early-stage.

原文标题：MIT CSAIL 实验 GPT-6 Astra 直接修改神经网络权重

Why it matters：展示了大模型作为“元编程”工具直接干预底层模型参数的新范式，具有极高的技术前瞻性。

This move aims to simplify product structure and consolidate usage quotas, pushing users toward a next-generation interface with enhanced execution capabilities.

item.title: Aisin Unveils World's First 16nm AI SoC with Integrated STT-MRAM, Boosting Efficiency 50x
item.description:
Aisin and Tohoku University have developed the world's first 16nm AI SoC integrating Spin-Transfer Torque MRAM (STT-MRAM). Utilizing a Near-Memory Computing architecture to store model weights directly on-chip, the solution reduces boot time significantly and achieves a 50x improvement in energy efficiency for object detection.

原文标题：爱信发布全球首款集成 STT-MRAM 的 16nm AI SoC，能效提升 50 倍

Why it matters：展示了新型非易失性存储器在边缘 AI 芯片中的实际落地能力，对低功耗推理场景具有参考价值。

item.title: Zyphra Introduces ZHA Hierarchical Attention for Efficient Long-Context Inference
item.description:
Zyphra introduces ZHA (Hierarchical Attention), a sparse attention method utilizing a tree structure over the KV cache for efficient retrieval. On Qwen3.6-35B, it outperforms dense attention on LongBench v2 while reading only ~1.1% of keys, with minimal training overhead (optimizing just 80k parameters). Although trade-offs exist in specific benchmarks like Terminal-Bench, it offers a novel architectural approach to long-context processing.

原文标题：Zyphra 发布 ZHA 分层注意力机制，长上下文推理效率显著提升

Why it matters：提出了一种新颖的分层稀疏注意力架构，在大幅降低计算量的同时保持了极具竞争力的长文本性能，对解决大模型长上下文瓶颈有重要参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Launches 'Grid Protectors' to Cut Data Center Power During Grid Overload
item.description:
OpenAI has launched the 'Grid Protectors' program, allowing utilities to remotely reduce data center power consumption during grid peaks. The first agreement with Georgia Power enables cutting up to 1,000MW from the Effingham County campus during demand surges, prioritizing residential supply. This initiative aims to mitigate growing community opposition to data centers while ensuring stable operation of large-scale compute infrastructure.

原文标题：OpenAI 推出 Grid Protectors 计划 承诺在电网过载时削减数据中心功耗

Why it matters：该事件标志着 AI 算力扩张与公共电网稳定性之间博弈进入制度化协调阶段，对关注基础设施可持续性的读者具有较高参考价值。

item.title: MIT Proposes Weight-Space Programming: GPT-6 Astra Edits Qwen Weights to Boost Math
item.description:
MIT CSAIL researchers introduced 'Weight-Space Programming,' a paradigm where frontier LLMs like GPT-6 Astra directly read and edit neural network weights without gradients or retraining. Experiments showed that modifying just 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights boosted its MATH-500 accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%, primarily by removing reasoning loops rather than adding new knowledge. This study demonstrates that LLMs can natively manipulate model parameters, offering a new path for AI self-improvement, though results await independent replication.

原文标题：MIT 提出权重空间编程：GPT-6 Astra 直接修改 Qwen 权重提升数学能力

Why it matters：颠覆传统训练范式，展示大模型直接编辑权重的可行性与显著效果，具有极高的技术前瞻性与行业影响力。

item.title: Anthropic IPO Filing Reveals $1.07T Compute Commitments
item.description:
Anthropic's amended IPO filing reveals up to $1.07 trillion in compute commitments, roughly 32 times its revenue. While sequential growth slowed to 47%, compute costs now account for 58% of sales, highlighting the massive infrastructure burden on large model developers.

Why it matters：该数据揭示了 AI 巨头在算力上的极端杠杆率与成本结构，对理解行业资本密集度具有关键参考价值。

item.title: LLM CLI v0.37 Adds Multimodal Embeddings and Endpoint Config
item.description:
Simon Willison's LLM CLI tool and Python library released version 0.37, introducing a command to easily configure OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The update switches the default model to the cheaper gpt-6-luna and enhances embedding support for multimodal binary content including text, audio, and images. The author also notes that while the project receives many AI-assisted pull requests, large language models are effectively used to triage and review these contributions.

原文标题：LLM CLI v0.37 发布 支持多模态嵌入与端点配置

Why it matters：开发者常用工具的重要更新，涉及多模态嵌入支持与工作流优化，具备一定实用价值。

Why it matters：展示了大模型时代基础设施如何为适应 AI 代理的高频并发操作而进行底层重构，具有工程参考价值。
